<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2059749_smart_0.getProblemDetails</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>getProblemDetails</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var getProblemDetails = Class.create();
getProblemDetails.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    getProblemTask: function(problem_sys_id) {
        var allTaks = [];
        var ptask = new GlideRecord('problem_task');
        ptask.addQuery('problem', problem_sys_id);
        ptask.query();
        while (ptask.next()) {
            allTaks.push(ptask.getDisplayValue('number'));
        }
        return allTaks;
    },

    getUserGroup: function(assigned_to) {
        var groups = [];
        var grp = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        grp.addQuery('user', assigned_to);
        grp.query();
        while (grp.next()) {
            groups.push(grp.getDisplayValue('group'));
        }
        return groups;
    },

    type: 'getProblemDetails'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-13 09:25:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>a88f13a393620310d16932ddfaba1096</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>getProblemDetails</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Smart Safety" source="x_2059749_smart_0">ac17c38f93520710d16932ddfaba107b</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Smart Safety">ac17c38f93520710d16932ddfaba107b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_a88f13a393620310d16932ddfaba1096</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-13 09:55:06</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
